'''Kimm Aurek''' was a dingy [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] located in the [[Kimm Aurek system/Legends|Kimm Aurek system]], one of the [[Kimm systems]] of the [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sector]], which was itself a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Senex-Juvex Loop]], which connected it to the [[Juvex system/Legends|Juvex]] and [[Kimm Besh system/Legends|Kimm Besh systems]]. Similarly to its Senex-Juvex Loop neighbors [[Kimm Besh]] and [[Kimm Cresh]], Kimm Aurek was under the control of [[House Sreethyn]], one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the region.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kimm Aurek was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-18.<ref name="TEA" />
